name: cover__level_via_engine
description: WindowCovering cluster (0x0102) attribute CurrentPositionLiftPercent100ths (0x000E) on endpoint 3 emits ReportData on a fresh bridge-initiated exchange when the subscription engine drains a dirty mark. Locks the cluster-agnostic invariant: F4 holds regardless of which cluster ID drives the subscription — if reportSubscription regresses to reusing the peer-opened Subscribe exchange, this scenario fails with the same ExchangeID-equals-Subscribe diagnostic as switch__ccu_echo_via_engine.
